io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.authentication: One complete MCP product case is free. Start market_access_check with a plain-language message and no case_id. Then follow the returned state and next_action, carrying the opaque case_id unchanged. Answer clarification questions by their stable keys. Stage 2 runs after seller confirmation or an active case-scoped delegation. Browser actions declare delegated_execution: an agent with the listed authority and required capability may complete them; otherwise give the URL to the seller. Payment needs a separate mandate covering the displayed amount, currency and terms. Never infer permission. A new product or SKU requires paid API access. describe_coverage and watch_product_regulatory_changes stay open.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.safetyBoundary: Market-access readiness only. Not legal advice, certification, product approval, or marketplace approval guarantee.
